If there is one birthday wish, it's to keep donating to @LatNewsletter. We are going into our THIRD YEAR and the only way to keep going is because of YOU. 

It takes just a minute to give at the DONATE link at TheLatinoNewsletter.org or at bit.ly/SupportTLN
It's been a journey and I am grateful for having a family that loves me, friends that are there for me and a community that supports my work.
They say age is just a number but it's still a number. So today I turned 57. I was born the same year the Mets won the World Series and humans landed on the moon.

I will start sharing the WHY soon about @LatNewsletter and @Shake_It_Easy_ co-producing a podcast about #PuertoRico, but for now, making this announcement is a lifelong dream fulfilled.
